message: The other day, as the skies darkened and the wind picked up, I found myself digging out the old board games from the closet. It was a delightful reminder that when the weather turns wild, you can still have a bit of fun without relying on screens. We spent the evening laughing over too many rounds of Scrabble—who knew my grandson could spell 'quizzify'? It got me thinking: maybe a little low-tech entertainment is just what we need to weather the storm. What’s your go-to game when the power goes out? 🎲
